WITH sessions_with_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitId,
    device.deviceCategory,
    visitStartTime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as hits
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND totals.transactions > 0
),
first_trans_per_visitor AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_trans_date
  FROM sessions_with_trans
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_visit_per_visitor AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_trans_session AS (
  SELECT 
    st.fullVisitorId,
    st.date,
    st.deviceCategory,
    st.visitId,
    st.visitStartTime,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY st.fullVisitorId, st.date ORDER BY st.visitStartTime) as rn
  FROM sessions_with_trans st
  JOIN first_trans_per_visitor ft ON st.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId AND st.date = ft.first_trans_date
)
SELECT 
  fts.fullVisitorId,
  fvp.first_visit_date,
  fts.date as first_trans_date,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fts.date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fvp.first_visit_date), DAY) as days_elapsed,
  fts.deviceCategory
FROM first_trans_session fts
JOIN first_visit_per_visitor fvp ON fts.fullVisitorId = fvp.fullVisitorId
WHERE fts.rn = 1
ORDER BY fts.fullVisitorId

WITH target_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId, visitId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND trafficSource.campaign LIKE '%Data Share%'
),
all_page_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    s.visitId,
    h.hitNumber,
    h.page.pagePath,
    h.time
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
  INNER JOIN target_sessions t ON s.fullVisitorId = t.fullVisitorId AND s.visitId = t.visitId
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_with_next AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId, visitId, hitNumber, pagePath, time,
    LEAD(pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) AS next_page_path,
    LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) AS next_time
  FROM all_page_hits
  WHERE pagePath LIKE '/home%'
),
most_common_next AS (
  SELECT next_page_path
  FROM home_with_next
  WHERE next_page_path IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY next_page_path
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT CAST(FLOOR(SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(next_time - time), 1000)) AS INT64) as max_time_seconds
  FROM home_with_next
  WHERE next_page_path IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT mcn.next_page_path AS most_common_next_page, mt.max_time_seconds
FROM most_common_next mcn
CROSS JOIN max_time mt

SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH)) AS month,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '3' THEN fullVisitorId END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2' THEN fullVisitorId END)
  ) * 100, 2) AS add_to_cart_rate,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6' THEN fullVisitorId END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2' THEN fullVisitorId END)
  ) * 100, 2) AS purchase_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, UNNEST(hits) h
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170331'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

-- Final query with ROUND
WITH new_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` 
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170430'
    AND totals.newVisits = 1
),
initial_visits AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, totals.timeOnSite as timeOnSite
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170430'
    AND totals.newVisits = 1
    AND visitNumber = 1
),
users_with_long_initial AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId
  FROM initial_visits
  WHERE timeOnSite > 300
),
subsequent_purchases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions > 0
    AND visitNumber > 1
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(DISTINCT u.fullVisitorId) * 100,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM new_users)
    ),
    2
  ) as percentage
FROM users_with_long_initial u
JOIN subsequent_purchases p ON u.fullVisitorId = p.fullVisitorId

SELECT provider_city,
       SUM(total_discharges) AS total_discharges,
       SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
  AND provider_city IN ('NEW YORK', 'BOSTON', 'SPRINGFIELD')
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY total_discharges DESC

SELECT 
  CAST(year AS INT64) AS year,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(temp AS FLOAT64)), 1) AS avg_temp,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64)), 1) AS avg_wind_speed,
  ROUND(AVG(SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64)), 2) AS precipitation
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE stn = '725030' 
  AND mo = '06' 
  AND da = '12' 
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH all_data AS (
  SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2005`
  UNION ALL SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2006`
  UNION ALL SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2007`
  UNION ALL SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2008`
  UNION ALL SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2009`
  UNION ALL SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010`
  UNION ALL SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011`
  UNION ALL SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012`
  UNION ALL SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013`
  UNION ALL SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014`
  UNION ALL SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2015`
),
daily_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    year, month, day,
    AVG(latitude) as latitude,
    AVG(longitude) as longitude,
    AVG(wind_speed) as avg_wind_speed
  FROM all_data
  WHERE wind_speed IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month, day
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    year, month, day,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    avg_wind_speed,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_wind_speed DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_avg
)
SELECT 
  latitude,
  longitude,
  DATE(year, month, day) as date,
  ROUND(avg_wind_speed, 2) as avg_wind_speed
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY avg_wind_speed DESC

SELECT 
  CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS date,
  temp AS avg_temp
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2009`
WHERE stn = '723758' AND mo = '10'
ORDER BY temp DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH top_station AS (
  SELECT start_station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
    AND starttime IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY start_station_id
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
top_station_dow AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM starttime) as day_of_week, COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = (SELECT start_station_id FROM top_station)
    AND starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
  GROUP BY day_of_week
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
top_station_hour AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) as hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = (SELECT start_station_id FROM top_station)
    AND starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
  GROUP BY hour_of_day
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.day_of_week, h.hour_of_day
FROM top_station_dow d, top_station_hour h

SELECT
  AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, MINUTE)) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes
FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pz
  ON t.pickup_location_id = pz.zone_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dz
  ON t.dropoff_location_id = dz.zone_id
WHERE t.data_file_year = 2016
  AND t.data_file_month = 2
  AND t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-02-01'
  AND t.pickup_datetime < '2016-02-08'
  AND t.passenger_count > 3
  AND t.trip_distance >= 10
  AND pz.borough = 'Brooklyn'
  AND dz.borough = 'Brooklyn'

SELECT 
  t.bike_number,
  SUM(
    6371000 * ACOS(
      COS(s.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS(e.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * 
      COS((e.longitude - s.longitude) * 3.14159265358979 / 180) + 
      SIN(s.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * SIN(e.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180)
    )
  ) AS total_distance_meters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s 
  ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` e 
  ON t.end_station_id = e.station_id
GROUP BY t.bike_number
ORDER BY bike_number

WITH monthly_minutes AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(end_date AS DATE)) AS month,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(duration_sec) / 60.0 AS total_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(end_date AS DATE)) = 2017
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Subscriber', 'Customer')
  GROUP BY month, subscriber_type
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS customer_minutes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS subscriber_minutes
  FROM monthly_minutes
  GROUP BY month
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 
  UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    am.month,
    COALESCE(p.customer_minutes, 0) AS customer_minutes,
    COALESCE(p.subscriber_minutes, 0) AS subscriber_minutes
  FROM all_months am
  LEFT JOIN pivoted p ON am.month = p.month
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    customer_minutes,
    subscriber_minutes,
    SUM(customer_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cum_customer,
    SUM(subscriber_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cum_subscriber,
    ABS(SUM(customer_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY month) - SUM(subscriber_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / 1000.0 AS abs_diff_thousands
  FROM joined
)
SELECT * FROM cumulative ORDER BY month

WITH berkeley_stations AS (
  SELECT CAST(station_id AS INT64) AS station_id 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` 
  WHERE region_id = 14
),
berkeley_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.duration_sec,
    ST_DISTANCE(t.start_station_geom, t.end_station_geom) AS distance_meters
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
  WHERE t.start_station_id IN (SELECT station_id FROM berkeley_stations)
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(MAX(SAFE_DIVIDE(distance_meters, duration_sec)), 1) AS highest_avg_speed_ms,
  COUNT(*) AS qualifying_trips
FROM berkeley_trips
WHERE distance_meters > 1000

WITH under20 AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN age BETWEEN 0 AND 19 THEN population ELSE 0 END) AS pop_under20
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2020
  GROUP BY country_name
),
total_pop AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    SUM(population) AS midyear_population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2020
  GROUP BY country_name
)
SELECT 
  u.country_name,
  u.pop_under20,
  t.midyear_population,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(u.pop_under20, t.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under20
FROM under20 u
JOIN total_pop t ON u.country_name = t.country_name
ORDER BY pct_under20 DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  'United States' as country,
  ROUND(SAFE_CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN SAFE_CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) END) AS FLOAT64), 4) as avg_anxiety_2019,
  ROUND(SAFE_CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN SAFE_CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) END) AS FLOAT64), 4) as avg_depression_2019,
  ROUND(SAFE_CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN SAFE_CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) END) AS FLOAT64), 4) as avg_anxiety_2020,
  ROUND(SAFE_CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN SAFE_CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) END) AS FLOAT64), 4) as avg_depression_2020,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SAFE_CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN SAFE_CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) END) AS FLOAT64) - 
    SAFE_CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN SAFE_CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) END) AS FLOAT64),
    SAFE_CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN SAFE_CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) END) AS FLOAT64)
  ) * 100, 4) as pct_increase_anxiety,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SAFE_CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN SAFE_CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) END) AS FLOAT64) - 
    SAFE_CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN SAFE_CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) END) AS FLOAT64),
    SAFE_CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN SAFE_CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) END) AS FLOAT64)
  ) * 100, 4) as pct_increase_depression
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_country_weekly`
WHERE country_region = 'United States'
  AND (
    (date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01')
    OR 
    (date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01')
  )

WITH top_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT team_market, player_id
  FROM (
    SELECT team_market, player_id, SUM(points_scored) as period2_points
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
    WHERE season BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018
      AND period = 2
      AND points_scored IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY team_market, player_id
    HAVING SUM(points_scored) >= 15
  )
  WHERE team_market IN (
    SELECT team_market FROM (
      SELECT team_market, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) as cnt
      FROM (
        SELECT team_market, player_id, SUM(points_scored) as period2_points
        FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
        WHERE season BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018
          AND period = 2
          AND points_scored IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY team_market, player_id
        HAVING SUM(points_scored) >= 15
      )
      GROUP BY team_market
      ORDER BY cnt DESC
      LIMIT 5
    )
  )
)
SELECT DISTINCT tp.team_market as top_market, tp.player_id, pgs.game_id, pgs.season, pgs.scheduled_date, pgs.tournament_type, pgs.tournament_round, pgs.team_market as game_team_market, pgs.team_name, pgs.points
FROM top_players tp
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_players_games_sr` pgs
  ON tp.player_id = pgs.player_id
  AND pgs.tournament = 'NCAA'
  AND pgs.season BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018
ORDER BY tp.team_market, tp.player_id, pgs.season, pgs.game_id

WITH latest_eval AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group_sequence_number, evaluation_group,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state_code ORDER BY evaluation_group_sequence_number DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT state_code, evaluation_group_sequence_number, evaluation_group
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
    WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  )
),
latest AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group_sequence_number, evaluation_group
  FROM latest_eval WHERE rn = 1
),
pop_filtered AS (
  SELECT p.plot_sequence_number, p.state_code, p.evaluation_group_sequence_number, p.evaluation_group,
         p.expansion_factor, p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN latest l ON p.state_code = l.state_code AND p.evaluation_group_sequence_number = l.evaluation_group_sequence_number
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
condition_acres AS (
  SELECT pf.state_code, pf.evaluation_group, c.state_code_name, c.condition_status_code, c.reserved_status_code, c.site_productivity_class_code, c.proportion_basis,
         pf.expansion_factor, c.condition_proportion_unadjusted,
         CASE 
           WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND pf.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN pf.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
           WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND pf.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN pf.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
           ELSE NULL
         END as adj_factor
  FROM pop_filtered pf
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON pf.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number AND pf.state_code = c.state_code
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT state_code, state_code_name, evaluation_group,
       SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 AND reserved_status_code = 0 AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6 
                AND adj_factor IS NOT NULL 
                THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted * adj_factor ELSE 0 END) as timberland_acres,
       SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 
                AND adj_factor IS NOT NULL 
                THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted * adj_factor ELSE 0 END) as forestland_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  GROUP BY state_code, state_code_name, evaluation_group
),
timberland_ranked AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, state_code_name, timberland_acres,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY timberland_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM state_totals
),
forestland_ranked AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, state_code_name, forestland_acres,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY forestland_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM state_totals
)
SELECT 'timberland' as category, tr.state_code, tr.evaluation_group, tr.state_code_name, tr.timberland_acres as total_acres
FROM timberland_ranked tr
WHERE tr.rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forestland' as category, fr.state_code, fr.evaluation_group, fr.state_code_name, fr.forestland_acres as total_acres
FROM forestland_ranked fr
WHERE fr.rn = 1

WITH subplot_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.plot_state_code as state_code,
    pt.plot_inventory_year as inventory_year,
    p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot as plot_size
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree` pt
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON pt.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p ON pt.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE pt.plot_inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
    AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    AND c.condition_status_code = 1
    AND c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP'
    AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0
),
macroplot_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.plot_state_code as state_code,
    pt.plot_inventory_year as inventory_year,
    p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot as plot_size
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree` pt
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON pt.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p ON pt.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE pt.plot_inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
    AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    AND c.condition_status_code = 1
    AND c.proportion_basis = 'MACR'
    AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0
),
avg_subplot AS (
  SELECT state_code, inventory_year, AVG(plot_size) as avg_size
  FROM subplot_sizes
  GROUP BY state_code, inventory_year
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_size DESC) = 1
),
avg_macroplot AS (
  SELECT state_code, inventory_year, AVG(plot_size) as avg_size
  FROM macroplot_sizes
  GROUP BY state_code, inventory_year
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_size DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 'subplot' as plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, avg_size
FROM avg_subplot
UNION ALL
SELECT 'macroplot' as plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, avg_size
FROM avg_macroplot
ORDER BY plot_type, inventory_year

WITH

),
question_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    question_id,
    SUM(answer_score) AS total_answer_score
  FROM answers_with_info
  GROUP BY question_id
),
ranked_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    ai.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ai.question_id ORDER BY ai.answer_score DESC, ai.answer_id ASC) AS score_rank
  FROM answers_with_info ai
  JOIN question_stats qs ON ai.question_id = qs.question_id
),
question_owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, CAST(question_owner_id AS INT64) AS user_id
  FROM questions
  WHERE question_owner_id IS NOT NULL
),
accepted_answer_owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.question_id, CAST(ai.answer_owner_id AS INT64) AS user_id

  FROM ranked_answers
  WHERE score_rank <= 3
),
all_associations AS (

  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM accepted_answer_owners
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM high_score_answers

  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM percent_score_answers

  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM top3_answers

WITH proteome_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    p.sample_id,

  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current` p

),
proteome_with_type AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.sample_id,

    pa.avg_protein_abundance,
    ai.sample_submitter_id,
    ai.sample_type
  FROM proteome_agg pa
  JOIN aliquot_info ai ON pa.sample_id = ai.sample_id
),
rna_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    r.sample_barcode,
    r.gene_name,
    AVG(r.fpkm_unstranded) AS avg_fpkm,
    r.sample_type_name,
    r.primary_site
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current` r
  WHERE r.primary_site = 'Kidney'
  GROUP BY r.sample_barcode, r.gene_name, r.sample_type_name, r.primary_site
),
joined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.sample_type,
    pt.gene_symbol,
    pt.avg_protein_abundance,
    ra.avg_fpkm,
    LOG(ra.avg_fpkm + 1) AS log_fpkm_plus_1
  FROM proteome_with_type pt
  JOIN rna_agg ra ON pt.sample_submitter_id = ra.sample_barcode 
    AND pt.gene_symbol = ra.gene_name
  WHERE pt.sample_type IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND ra.sample_type_name = pt.sample_type
    AND pt.avg_protein_abundance IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.avg_fpkm IS NOT NULL
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT 
    sample_type,
    gene_symbol,
    CORR(avg_protein_abundance, log_fpkm_plus_1) AS correlation
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY sample_type, gene_symbol
  HAVING CORR(avg_protein_abundance, log_fpkm_plus_1) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT sample_type, AVG(correlation) AS avg_correlation

WITH 
sorafenib_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
  WHERE i.drugID = 157 
    AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
pe_with_tas AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe_to.pe_stable_id, pe.uniprot_id,
    CASE WHEN pe.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN 'target' ELSE 'non-target' END as pe_type
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe_to
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON pe_to.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
  WHERE pe_to.evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
target_uniprot_per_pathway AS (
  SELECT pe_to.pathway_stable_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.uniprot_id) as targets_in_pathway
  FROM pe_with_tas pe
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe_to ON pe.pe_stable_id = pe_to.pe_stable_id
  WHERE pe.pe_type = 'target'
  GROUP BY pe_to.pathway_stable_id
),
non_target_pe_per_pathway AS (
  SELECT pe_to.pathway_stable_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.pe_stable_id) as non_targets_in_pathway
  FROM pe_with_tas pe
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe_to ON pe.pe_stable_id = pe_to.pe_stable_id
  WHERE pe.pe_type = 'non-target'
  GROUP BY pe_to.pathway_stable_id
),
total_non_targets AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pe_stable_id) as total_non_target_pes
  FROM pe_with_tas
  WHERE pe_type = 'non-target'
),
all_pathways AS (
  SELECT p.stable_id as pathway_stable_id, p.name as pathway_name
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p
  WHERE p.lowest_level = TRUE
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe_to
      WHERE pe_to.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id AND pe_to.evidence_code = 'TAS'
    )
)

SELECT 
  ap.pathway_stable_id,
  ap.pathway_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    POWER((COALESCE(tp.targets_in_pathway, 0) * (tn.total_non_target_pes - COALESCE(np.non_targets_in_pathway, 0)) - (40 - COALESCE(tp.targets_in_pathway, 0)) * COALESCE(np.non_targets_in_pathway, 0)), 2) * (40 + tn.total_non_target_pes),
    40.0 * tn.total_non_target_pes * (COALESCE(tp.targets_in_pathway, 0) + COALESCE(np.non_targets_in_pathway, 0)) * ((40 - COALESCE(tp.targets_in_pathway, 0)) + (tn.total_non_target_pes - COALESCE(np.non_targets_in_pathway, 0)))
  ) as chi_squared,
  COALESCE(tp.targets_in_pathway, 0) as targets_in_pathway,
  40 - COALESCE(tp.targets_in_pathway, 0) as targets_outside_pathway,
  COALESCE(np.non_targets_in_pathway, 0) as non_targets_in_pathway,
  tn.total_non_target_pes - COALESCE(np.non_targets_in_pathway, 0) as non_targets_outside_pathway
FROM all_pathways ap
LEFT JOIN target_uniprot_per_pathway tp ON ap.pathway_stable_id = tp.pathway_stable_id
LEFT JOIN non_target_pe_per_pathway np ON ap.pathway_stable_id = np.pathway_stable_id
CROSS JOIN total_non_targets tn
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC, ap.pathway_stable_id ASC
LIMIT 3

    CASE 
      WHEN r.remove_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND (r.remove_timestamp - i.install_timestamp) <= 7 * 86400000000 
      THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END as qualifies
  FROM installs i
  LEFT JOIN removals r ON i.user_pseudo_id = r.user_pseudo_id
)

  SUM(qualifies) as qualifying_users,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(qualifies), COUNT(*)) * 100 as percentage

WITH 
-- Step 1: Find cohort users (first event in July 2-8, 2018)
cohort_users AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', MIN(event_date)), WEEK(MONDAY)) as cohort_week
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', MIN(event_date)), WEEK(MONDAY)) = DATE '2018-07-02'
),
-- Step 2: For each event of cohort users, determine which Monday-week it falls in
user_weekly_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.cohort_week,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date), WEEK(MONDAY)) as activity_week
  FROM cohort_users c
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
),
-- Step 3: Count distinct users per cohort_week + activity_week
weekly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_week,
    activity_week,
    DATE_DIFF(activity_week, cohort_week, WEEK) as week_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) as retained_users
  FROM user_weekly_activity
  GROUP BY cohort_week, activity_week
),
-- Step 4: Get cohort size
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) as new_users FROM cohort_users
)
SELECT 
  CONCAT('Week ', CAST(week_number AS STRING)) as week,
  cs.new_users as total_new_users,
  wc.retained_users
FROM weekly_counts wc
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
WHERE week_number BETWEEN 0 AND 4
ORDER BY week_number
